# Vision preparation fixtures

`face_crop_reference.bin` is a 112x112 raw grayscale crop produced by the
`p1-clips/12` reference recipe on the synthetic 128x96 RGBA pattern generated by
the `face_crop_matches_reference_recipe_with_padding` test:

- face box `(84, 34, 32, 32)`, expansion `0.40`, missing pixels padded with gray 110;
- BGR-to-grayscale conversion, `cv2.resize(..., (224, 224), INTER_LINEAR)`;
- centre crop `[56..168, 56..168]`.

The pattern is synthetic; no private excerpt pixels are stored here. The test
allows two gray levels because OpenCV's one-channel 8-bit `INTER_LINEAR` path is
not bit-exact fixed-point interpolation. The measured match against the
`p1-clips/12` excerpt itself is reported in the media README.
